description: This file implements a store for managing user access tokens in a Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, enabling/disabling tokens, and related session management.

classes.name: SqlUserAccessTokenStore
classes.description: A store for managing user access tokens, including CRUD operations and session management.

methods.name: newSqlUserAccessTokenStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlUserAccessTokenStore with a given SqlStore.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new user access token to the database after validation.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a user access token by its ID, including associated sessions.

methods.name: deleteSessionsAndTokensById
methods.description: Deletes sessions and the token itself by token ID.

methods.name: deleteTokensById
methods.description: Deletes a token by its ID.

methods.name: DeleteAllForUser
methods.description: Deletes all tokens and sessions associated with a specific user.

methods.name: deleteSessionsandTokensByUser
methods.description: Deletes sessions and tokens for a specific user.

methods.name: deleteTokensByUser
methods.description: Deletes tokens for a specific user.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a user access token by its ID.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all user access tokens with pagination.

methods.name: GetByToken
methods.description: Retrieves a user access token by its token string.

methods.name: GetByUser
methods.description: Retrieves tokens for a specific user with pagination.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for tokens matching a search term across multiple fields.

methods.name: UpdateTokenEnable
methods.description: Enables a token by setting IsActive to true.

methods.name: UpdateTokenDisable
methods.description: Disables a token and deletes associated sessions.

methods.name: deleteSessionsAndDisableToken
methods.description: Deletes sessions and disables a token.

methods.name: updateTokenDisable
methods.description: Sets a token's IsActive status to false.
